name: Cycroid
desc: The most lovable and friendly of all the Vehicroids. It can arm itself with training wheels!

name: Soitsu
desc: Apparently totally unreliable, he wonders if he has incredible potential.

name: Mad Lobster
desc: A gourmet food renowned by the Dark World upper crust. It has sensational flavor.

name: Jerry Beans Man
desc: Jerry, a bean soldier, believes he is the strongest warrior in the world, but his true abilities are still untested.

name: Winged Kuriboh LV10
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Transcendent Wings". During your opponent's Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this face-up card; destroy as many Attack Position monsters your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the combined original ATK of those destroyed monster(s).

name: Patroid
desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can look at 1 face-down card your opponent controls, then return it to its original position.

name: Gyroid
desc: The first time this card would be destroyed by battle each turn, it is not destroyed.

name: Steamroid
desc: If this card attacks an opponent's monster, this card gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step only. If this card is attacked by an opponent's monster, this card loses 500 ATK during the Damage Step only.

name: Drillroid
desc: Before damage calculation, if this card attacks a Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster.

name: UFOroid
desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Machine monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck in face-up Attack Position.

name: Jetroid
desc: At the time this card is selected as an attack target by an opponent's monster, you can activate Trap Card(s) from your hand.

name: Wroughtweiler
desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Target 1 "Elemental HERO" card and 1 "Polymerization" in your GY; add them to your hand.

name: Dark Catapulter
desc:
Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Place 1 counter on this card. This card must be in face-up Defense Position to activate and to resolve this effect. You can banish cards in your GY equal to the number of counters on this card, then target that many Spells/Traps on the field; destroy them, then remove all counters from this card.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

name: Elemental HERO Bubbleman
desc: If this is the only card in your hand, you can Special Summon it (from your hand). When this card is Summoned: You can draw 2 cards. You must control no other cards and have no cards in your hand to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Cyber Dragon
desc: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

name: Cybernetic Magician
desc: You can discard 1 card to target 1 face-up monster on the field; that target's ATK becomes 2000 until the End Phase.

name: Cybernetic Cyclopean
desc: While you have no cards in your hand, this card gains 1000 ATK.

name: Mechanical Hound
desc: While you have no cards in your hand, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards.

name: Cyber Archfiend
desc: At the beginning of your Draw Phase, if you have no cards in your hand, draw 1 more card in addition to your normal draw. During your End Phase, if you have 1 or more card(s) in your hand, destroy this card.

name: Goblin Elite Attack Force
desc: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase, and its battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn.

name: B.E.S. Crystal Core
desc: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can change 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls to face-up Defense Position.

name: Giant Kozaky
desc: If there is no face-up "Kozaky" on the field, destroy this card. If this face-up card is destroyed, inflict damage equal to the original ATK of this card to its current controller.

name: Indomitable Fighter Lei Lei
desc: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. This card's battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn, except with a card effect.

name: Protective Soul Ailin
desc: Once per turn, you can equip this card to an "Indomitable Fighter Lei Lei" you control, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. When equipped to a monster by this card's effect, you can change that monster's battle position once per turn. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)

name: Doitsu
desc: Once per turn, you can equip this card to a "Soitsu" you control, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. When equipped to a monster by this card's effect, that monster gains 2500 ATK. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)

name: Des Frog
desc: When this card is Tribute Summoned, you can Special Summon "Des Frog"(s) from your hand or Deck up to the number of "T.A.D.P.O.L.E."(s) in your Graveyard.

name: T.A.D.P.O.L.E.
desc: When this card you control is destroyed by battle and sent to your Graveyard, you can add any "T.A.D.P.O.L.E."(s) from your Deck to your hand.

name: Poison Draw Frog
desc:
When this face-up card is sent from the field to the GY: You can draw 1 card.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

name: Beelze Frog
desc: This card gains 300 ATK for each "T.A.D.P.O.L.E." in your Graveyard.

name: Batteryman C
desc: If all "Batteryman C"(s) you control are in Attack Position, all Machine-Type monsters you control gain 500 ATK for each "Batteryman C" you control. If all "Batteryman C"(s) you control are in Defense Position, all Machine-Type monsters you control gain 500 DEF for each "Batteryman C" you control.

name: Ebon Magician Curran
desc: During your Standby Phase, inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each monster they control.

name: D.D.M. - Different Dimension Master
desc: Once per turn: You can discard 1 Spell, then target 1 of your banished monsters; Special Summon that target.

name: Steam Gyroid
desc: "Gyroid" + "Steamroid"

name: UFOroid Fighter
desc:
"UFOroid" + 1 Warrior monster
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. The original ATK/DEF of this card become the combined original ATK of the 2 materials used for its Fusion Summon.

name: Cyber Twin Dragon
desc:
"Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

name: Cyber End Dragon
desc:
"Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

name: Power Bond
desc: Fusion Summon 1 Machine Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material, and it gains ATK equal to its original ATK. During the End Phase of the turn this card is activated, you take damage equal to the amount of ATK gained from this effect at the time of the Summon.

name: Fusion Recovery
desc: Target 1 "Polymerization" in your GY, and 1 monster in your GY that was used as material for a Fusion Summon; add them to your hand.

name: Miracle Fusion
desc: Fusion Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials mentioned on it from your field or GY.

name: Dragon's Mirror
desc: Fusion Summon 1 Dragon Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from your field or GY.

name: System Down
desc: Pay 1000 LP; banish all Machine-Type monsters your opponent controls and in their Graveyard.

name: Des Croaking
desc: Activate only while you control 3 face-up "Des Frogs". Destroy all cards your opponent controls.

name: Pot of Generosity
desc: Return 2 cards from your hand to your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.

name: Shien's Spy
desc: Target 1 face-up monster you control; give control of it to your opponent until the End Phase of this turn.

name: Transcendent Wings
desc: Send 1 face-up or face-down "Winged Kuriboh" you control and 2 cards from your hand to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Winged Kuriboh LV10" from your hand or Deck.

name: Bubble Shuffle
desc: Target 1 face-up Attack Position "Elemental HERO Bubbleman" you control and 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls; change both those targets to Defense Position, then Tribute that "Elemental HERO Bubbleman", then Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your hand.

name: Spark Blaster
desc: Equip only to "Elemental HERO Sparkman". During your Main Phase: You can target 1 face-up monster; change the battle position of that target. After you use this effect 3 times, destroy this card.

name: Spiritual Fire Art - Kurenai
desc: Tribute 1 FIRE monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK.

name: Fire Darts
desc: You can only activate this card when you have no cards in your hand. Roll a six-sided die 3 times, and inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the total result of the die rolls x 100 points.

name: Spiritual Water Art - Aoi
desc: Tribute 1 WATER monster; look at your opponent's hand, then send 1 card from their hand to the GY.

name: D.D. Trap Hole
desc: When your opponent Sets exactly 1 monster (and no other cards): Target that Set monster and 1 monster you control; destroy those targets, and if you do, banish them.

name: A Rival Appears!
desc: Select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. Special Summon 1 monster from your hand that has the same Level as the selected monster.

name: Prepare to Strike Back
desc: Each time your opponent declares a face-up Defense Position monster as an attack target, toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, change the targeted monster to Attack Position. If you call it wrong, the controller of this card takes damage equal to the amount that the ATK of the attacking monster is higher than the DEF of the attack target.

name: Spiritual Earth Art - Kurogane
desc: Tribute 1 EARTH monster and target 1 other Level 4 or lower EARTH monster in your GY; Special Summon that EARTH monster.

name: Magical Explosion
desc: Activate only while you have no cards in your hand. Inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each Spell Card in your Graveyard.

name: Rising Energy
desc: Discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; that target gains 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

name: Dimension Wall
desc: Activate only when an opponent's monster declares an attack. Instead of you, your opponent takes the Battle Damage you would have taken from this battle.

name: Level Modulation
desc: Your opponent draws 2 cards. Special Summon 1 "LV" monster from your Graveyard, ignoring the Summoning conditions. The monster that was Special Summoned by this effect cannot attack, nor activate or apply its effect this turn.

name: Mispolymerization
desc: Activate only when a Fusion Monster is Special Summoned. Return all face-up Fusion Monsters to their respective Extra Decks.

name: Cyber Shadow Gardna
desc: During your opponent's Main Phase: Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Machine/EARTH/Level 4/ATK ?/DEF ?). (This card is also still a Trap.) When an opponent's monster declares an attack that targets this card: The ATK/DEF of this card become the ATK/DEF of the attacking monster. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: Set this card in its Spell & Trap Zone.
